messages:
sam_support: Heads-up — escalated P1 from Aurelia Health onboarding. SSO (Okta) throws SAML audience mismatch for ~20% of users during initial login. Ticket #4321. Renewal in ~30 days, client already flagged frustration in their CSM check-in. Need CS comms + priority handling. Error snippet below:

sam_support: ```
2024-06-12T08:10:03Z ERROR auth.saml: SAML response invalid: AudienceRestriction failed for assertion id=abc123
User: user@aurelia.health
request_id=1fd2a3
```

sam_support: They are on Hosted API (us-west). Model pinned to text-redwood-3-small. Also reported intermittent 403 when exchanging tokens after SSO success — unclear if separate. Attaching link to support ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4321

dana_cs: @sam_support thanks for the flag. I'm taking lead on CS comms. Quick Q: do we have an impact window (how many minutes/hours) and a reproducible user flow we can show them? Lina / AE looped? :eyes:

lina_account_exec: On it — I was on today's call. They said ~15% of logins fail for their billing/admin group, causing blocked access to setup steps. They mentioned contract renewal next month and want clarity on risk. I'll join the triage call.

mike_infra: ping — infra notes a spike in auth errors around 08:00 UTC, looks correlated to a metadata rotation from Okta side. Temporary mitigation: allow fallback to legacy SAML audience (we can toggle for this tenant). I can flip it, but want CS signoff before changing tenant-level auth behavior.

anna_se: I can run a live repro with their admin on call and do a guided session. Recommend a short enablement + repro call (30m) and share temporary workaround while infra toggles fallback. I can host at 16:00 PT today.

sam_support: Repro steps: create new user in Okta -> trigger SP-initiated login -> observe SAML response error. I added logs and screenshots in ticket. Also noticed one user succeeded after clearing browser cookies. Possibly subtle session binding.

dana_cs: Draft comm plan from CS perspective:
• Immediate: schedule 30m enablement + repro call (Anna + Sam + Mike + Lina) today.
• Short-term workaround: infra toggles legacy-audience fallback for Aurelia tenant (Mike to confirm).
• Customer update: send status + ETA within 2 hours. Template below.
• Follow-up: post-mortem + confirm fix landed before renewal check-in.

dana_cs: Proposed customer update template (short):
"Hi Team Aurelia — thanks for the call today. We're treating this as P1 for onboarding. We have a temporary auth fallback ready and will run a guided repro session at 16:00 PT to validate. We'll follow up with a permanent fix timeline within 48 hours. — Dana, CSM"

mike_infra: I can enable fallback now for this tenant; toggle will be reversible and low-risk. Plan: enable -> monitor 30m -> if successful, keep and schedule root-cause patch. Will post when done.

ops_bot: [deployment] service-auth toggled: fallback-audience=enabled for tenant=aurelia-health by mike_infra at 2024-06-12T12:15:32Z

sam_support: Verified with customer on call — login success for previously failing admin user after fallback toggle. Sending confirmation to ticket.

lina_account_exec: Sending renewal note to customer saying we resolved immediate login blocker and will share RCA. Good to add mention of a targeted follow-up a week before renewal.

dana_cs: Action items assigned:
• dana_cs: draft and send the 2-hour update (includes incident details + meeting invite)
• mike_infra: enable fallback (done) + schedule root-cause patch
• anna_se: run 16:00 PT repro/enablement session
• sam_support: consolidate logs/screenshots in SUP-4321 and mark ticket P1 -> escalated-to-cs
• lina_account_exec: send renewal reassurance note and loop sales leadership if we see churn risk

sam_support: I'll update the ticket now and include confirmation screenshots. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

dana_cs: I'll take ownership of the comms path and post the final customer note in this thread after sending. Please @mention me in any new infra updates.

lina_account_exec: noted. If we see any pushback on the contract timeline I'll escalate to legal/partnerships.

mike_infra: Monitoring looks good after toggle. No spike in errors for the tenant in last 45m. Will open a JIRA for the permanent patch and link it to SUP-4321.

dana_cs: Final note sent to customer at 13:05 PT. Copy pasted into the ticket. Thanks team — will keep this thread updated with RCA and post-mortem link. :white_check_mark:
